borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions: The proposed development, by reason of design and layout, would fail to provide an adequate quality of accommodation for future occupiers. In particular, the proposed units would be poorly laid out, resulting in noise issues and sufficient amenity for units capable of accommodating families. The proposal would therefore be harmful to the living conditions of future occupiers, contrary to the following policies which seek to ensure that development proposals provide a high standard of amenity:National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December, 2024)Policies D6 and D14 of the London Plan (March 2021);Policies SP2, DMD1 and DMSI3 of The Barking and Dagenham Local Plan (September, 2024)Housing Design Standards LPG (June 2023)

In the absence of further information on the proposed parking, the proposal fails to demonstrate whether sufficient car parking provision would be made or whether this could be adequately accommodated in the surrounding area. In the absence of such, the proposal is found to result in unacceptable parking stress and congestion in the vicinity of the application site.  As such, it fails to comply with the following policies:National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December 2024)Policies T1 and T6.1 of the London Plan (March 2021)Policy DMT2 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan (September 2024)
description: Construction of a front porch, a two storey front infill extension and a first floor rear and side extension to facilitate the conversion of the existing dwellinghouse into 2x self- contained flats (1x 3- bed, 5 person and 1x 2- bed, 4 person)
